title: SonicWall TZ370W Wireless SecureUpgrade (Open Box)

comparisons.notes: Model 02-SSC-6835, TZ370 Wireless-AC Secure Upgrade Plus Advanced Edition 3 Years, new, in stock

writeup: Woot has an open-box SonicWall TZ370W wireless firewall bundled with the 3-year Secure Upgrade Plus Advanced Edition license (02-SSC-6835) for $911.94. The same new bundle runs $2,259.65 at 1Stop and $2,761.49 at RetailMarket, so this is about 59% less. Note that Secure Upgrade Plus requires a qualifying trade-in device, and an open-box license may already be registered, so confirm with SonicWall before relying on the 3-year subscription. Only one was left when we checked.
